title: finding(plugin-list/plugin-tree/plugin-charts): the toolbar Search is offered on tree and chart list views but reaches neither view's own query
body:
Ruled: 5825585515 · letter A (no toolbar Search on tree/chart) · 2026-09-25T02:18Z

Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The sites: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (what the tree and chart nodes carry), `packages/plugin-tree` (`ObjectTree`'s object-provider query) and `packages/plugin-charts` (`ObjectChart`'s aggregate call).

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10250 (PR objectui#10323). The dev measured it; ⛔ it is filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`ListView`'s toolbar offers **Search** on every view: its visibility flag tests no view type. On a `tree` or an object-bound `chart` list view, the typed term changes `ListView`'s own fetch (`$search`) and **nothing drawn**. Both views query for themselves, and neither query carries the term. There is no error and no hint.

objectui#10250 (PR objectui#10323) fixed the toolbar **Filter and chips** on these two views and the toolbar **Search** on gantt. Search on tree and chart was left out on purpose, because neither is a one-line forwarding:

| view | what its own query does with the term | what a fix needs |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `tree` | `ObjectTree`'s object-provider `find` carries `$filter`, `$top` and `$expand`, but no `$search` | a declared `ObjectTreeSchema` key plus a `plugin-tree` read, or Search withheld on tree views |
| object-bound `chart` | `ObjectChart`'s aggregate call (`field`, `function`, `groupBy`, `filter`) has no search parameter at all | a data-layer search on aggregate, or Search withheld on chart views. ⚠️ Which one is a product choice |

## Reproduction (the dev's real-renderer probe, on `main` `8b1f06619` and on PR head `3bd041e6a`, not committed)

- **tree:** host fetch sends `$search: "needle"`; the tree's own `find` is `{ $filter: [and, …], $top: 2001, $expand: [parent] }` with no `$search`.
- **chart:** host fetch sends `$search: "needle"`; the aggregate call carries no search.
- ⚠️ These readings are the dev's, relayed by the seat, ⛔ not re-run by the seat.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Same user-visible shape as objectui#10250 and objectui#10037: a control that changes nothing on screen.
- The chart half has a design fork (search the aggregate, or withhold the control). Triage may route that half to the decision box.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `(tree|chart) … search … (lost|never|not reach|ignor|drop)` / `$search … (ObjectTree|object-tree|aggregate)` / `searchTerm … (tree|chart)` ⇒ 1 hit, a seat registration post (noise). Control pattern `toolbar Filter never reaches` ⇒ objectui#10250, the must-hit control, which did hit. ⇒ No duplicate.

Dedupe words: `tree view toolbar search` · `ObjectTree $search` · `object-chart aggregate search` · `ListView searchTerm tree chart` · `self-querying view search`
